prior_id: MAINT-1 review (EXECUTION-STATUS SOON-1 row): plain HTTP
claim: Plain HTTP is redirected for the pages the script serves; files are covered by the zone's Always Use HTTPS (owner's dashboard switch)
evidence: Script part holds: `curl -sSI http://anas.studio/` -> `HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently`, `Location: https://anas.studio/`. The zone part is not done: `curl -sSI http://anas.studio/v/a/` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`, `Content-Type: text/html`; `curl -sSI http://www.anas.studio/og.png` -> 200 (2026-10-07). Tracked as open in EXECUTION-STATUS next work item 8, so not re-reported as a finding; the plain-HTTP 'files' include the six full design pages /v/<x>/ and /m/<x>/, not only images and fonts.
Live https://anas.studio/ and https://www.anas.studio/: `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000` (site/_headers line 10, copied onto the script's own responses by worker.js line 32).

claim: The deploy script passes wrangler nothing else from .env and pins its version
evidence: artifacts/soon/deploy.cjs lines 27-33: every name parsed from the root .env except CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is deleted from the child env; `npx --yes wrangler@4.114.0 deploy` runs in a mkdtemp copy holding only site/, worker.js and wrangler.toml (no .env for wrangler to load). WRANGLER_LOG_SANITIZE defaults to true (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/system-environment-variables/).
